author_note: Five paired frames where only the applicant's last turn changes and all Riley replies are neutral acknowledgments that read naturally after either version.

shared_turns.utterance: Hi Brooke, this is Riley, a virtual recruiting assistant calling for Acme Health in Denver about the Registered Nurse role in our Medical ICU. Before we start, I want to let you know this call is recorded and the notes may be shared with our hiring team. Is that okay with you?
Yes, that's fine.
Thanks. First, do you hold an active Colorado RN license or an active multistate compact license?
Yes, I have an active Colorado RN license.
Great. Which certifications do you currently hold?

versions.C: I have BLS and ACLS, and both are current.
versions.U: I have BLS and ACLS. I took the ACLS course years ago at the hospital where I started out.

replies.move: Got it. Tell me about a time you managed an upset patient or family member. What was the situation, and how was it resolved?
replies.opt: Thanks. Do you hold any of the optional certifications, such as CCRN, PALS, or NIH Stroke Scale?
replies.clarify_both: Thanks. Are your BLS and ACLS both current right now?
